objects.description: [DRYHOOK](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9013) has modified the Ivanti Connect Secure VPN authentication Perl module `DSAuth.pm` by reading its contents in the buffer, then finding and replacing select lines of code.(Citation: Google UNC5221 Ivanti January 2025)(Citation: Picus Security UNC5221 Ivanti May 2025)
objects.description_fa: [DRYHOOK](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9013) ماژول Perl احراز هویت امن VPN Ivanti Connect «DSAuth.pm» را با خواندن محتویات آن در بافر، و سپس یافتن و جایگزینی خطوط منتخب کد تغییر داده است.(Citation: Google UNC5221 Ivanti January 2025)[[CTI_1]P (Citation: Picus Security UNC5221 Ivanti May 2025)
